question: Can reciting the mantra twelve hundred thousand times transform even a mute person into a master of speech?
premises: The prescribed recitation count is twelve hundred thousand.
Even a mute person may perform this recitation.
The promised result is mastery of speech.
inference: By reciting twelve hundred thousand times, even a mute person would become a lord of speech.
plain_english: One should recite it twelve hundred thousand times; even a mute person would become a lord of speech.
